run_fix_literate_html: run the script to post-process Verso literate HTML output and fix deployment issues in a directory
inject_katex_into_html: inject KaTeX CSS and JS into a Verso HTML file to enable LaTeX rendering in docstrings
create_stub_js_files: create stub JavaScript files for missing Verso search infrastructure in the -verso-search directory
fix_domain_mappers_js: fix domain-mappers.js by removing export statements that cause syntax errors when loaded without type module
fix_all_html_files: walk a directory tree and inject KaTeX into all index.html files that are missing it
